QuestInfo.name: Maybe They Will Pass It On
QuestInfo.0: You wonder how you can deliver clothes to #p2154004#, who is being held hostage at the Black Wings' headquarters... #b#p2152006##k seems to have an idea.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152006# says #p2152016#, the Black Wing watchman, is delivering items to #p2154004#, and asks that you take the box containing clothes, food, and money to #b#p2152016##k.
QuestInfo.2: When #p2152016# received the box from #p2152006#, he immediately opened it. Then, #p2152016# took the food and money inside the box, leaving only the clothes. From what you saw, you can only assume that not much has been delivered to #p2154004# from #p2152006#.

0.0: I've packaged together some food, money, and clothes. Can you please deliver this to #b#p2152016##k, one of the Black Wings Watchmen? He has delivered items to #p2154004# before, so I'm sure he will do it again this time.

yes.0: Who would've thought a former Council President would have to deal with a Black Wing Watchman? I made an oath to protect this town... It would have been better if they had taken me prisoner instead.

no.0: Is it that you don't want to be a part of such a dirty job? I am embarrassed...but please. It's not for me, it's for poor #p2154004#. Please reconsider.

1.0: Hm? You're...#p2153003#, right? No? Well, no matter. What brings you here? Hey, what's in the box? Let's take a lookie. Oh, old #p2152006# must've sent another package. Thanks to him, I never run out of food!
1.1: #b(#p2152016# dumps the contents out of the box. He starts to munch on some of the food and slips the money into his pocket.)#k
1.2: Mm, tasty. And despite losing his job to #p2152007#, that old man still seems quite loaded. And what's this? Clothes?

yes.0: Eh, I can't wear this. Take it back. Eh? You want me to deliver it to #p2154004#? Eh, why bother? Not like she'll know whether I delivered it or not.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p2152016# yet? #p2152016# will be able to deliver the items to #p2154004##k.

item.0: Hmm... I'm so hungry. Anyone around that I can take their food from?
